=== ISSUE AGT-01
title: [AGT-01] Background runs: queue and schedule
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:agents
milestone: P5 Background and agents
---
**Phase:** P5 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v101, v102) · **Size:** L (guess, split it when the phase starts) · **Blocked by:** {{AI-01e}}, {{AI-02}}, {{CON-04a}}

## Goal
Many jobs can run on a schedule, and the owner sees and controls each run.

## Proposed change
- A Background runs screen with a queue (Waiting, Running, Done, Failed), with cancel and retry.
- A Schedule tab: each job has on, off, a time and "Run now".
- A daily limit of runs. Jobs pause at 95% of the usage limit.
- Build on the run table and queue from {{AI-01e}} and the timer from {{CON-04a}}. Do not rewrite them.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A scheduled job runs at its time while the app is open or in the tray.
- [ ] A failed run can be retried and shows its error.
- [ ] At the limit, waiting jobs pause and say why.

## Out of scope
- Running after Quit ({{LATER-07}}).
- The approval inbox ({{AGT-02}}).

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, AGT-01 and DEC-08: {{ROADMAP}}
- Architecture, "Job nền" (review the 95% pause line before P5): {{ARCH}}
- Prototype, Background runs (v101, v102): {{PROTO}}

=== ISSUE AGT-02
title: [AGT-02] Needs approval inbox and safety hooks
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:agents
milestone: P5 Background and agents
---
**Phase:** P5 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v101, v111) · **Size:** L (guess, split it when the phase starts) · **Blocked by:** {{AGT-01}}

## Goal
One inbox for every action that needs the owner. Nothing is written outside Mnemo before Approve.

## Proposed change
- An inbox for filing, memory lines, new projects and messages, with Approve, Edit then approve, Reject, and a history.
- A hook that blocks risky tool calls. A call to a private network address is blocked with no Approve button.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No outside write happens before Approve.
- [ ] Reject leaves no change.
- [ ] A blocked call shows which hook stopped it.

## Out of scope
- Automatic approval rules.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, AGT-02 and the rule "Nothing moves, deletes or sends without you": {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, Needs approval (v101, v111): {{PROTO}}
- Unverified: how Claude Code hooks work in `-p` mode with Mnemo's own settings file. Test it first.

=== ISSUE AGT-03
title: [AGT-03] Mnemo memory
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:agents
milestone: P5 Background and agents
---
**Phase:** P5 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v101) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{AGT-02}}

## Goal
Mnemo remembers what the owner taught it, and the owner approves every line.

## Proposed change
- Four memory parts: instructions, learned, already reported, progress.
- A new line is a proposal in the approval inbox. A weekly tidy job exists and is off by default.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No line is written before the owner approves it.
- [ ] A deleted line is not used in the next run.

## Out of scope
- Memory shared with the owner's own Claude Code.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, AGT-03: {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, Memory (v101): {{PROTO}}
- Open point: the roadmap says "four files", and the architecture puts data in SQLite. Decide where memory lives when the phase starts.

=== ISSUE DIG-01
title: [DIG-01] Daily digest: Top 10 from saved content
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:agents
milestone: P5 Background and agents
---
**Phase:** P5 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v10, v18 to v21, v85, v116, v119, v120) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{AGT-01}}, {{BM-01}}

## Goal
Each day the owner gets the 10 saved items most worth a look, with a reason for each.

## Proposed change
- A daily Top 10 from saved content. Each item shows why it is there.
- Actions per item: Save, Save and make a task, Dismiss.
- The digest runs by schedule and by hand.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each item shows why it is there.
- [ ] No summary is written for a page the app did not read.
- [ ] The digest runs by schedule and by hand.
- [ ] Phase exit: the digest runs by itself for one week, stops at the usage limit and never acts without approval.

## Out of scope
- Listening to the digest ({{LATER-05}}).

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, DIG-01 and the P5 exit check: {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, Digest (v85, v116, v119, v120): {{PROTO}}

=== ISSUE DIG-02
title: [DIG-02] Weekly digest, roast and dead-link check
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:agents
milestone: P5 Background and agents
---
**Phase:** P5 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** partly prototyped ("Drop the old links?" only) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{DIG-01}}, {{LIB-02}}

## Goal
A weekly look back that keeps the library clean and is fun to read.

## Proposed change
- A weekly report: near-duplicates, dead links and a short roast.
- Code writes every number. Claude writes only words.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every number in the roast equals the code count.
- [ ] A dead link is proposed for removal, never deleted by the app.

## Out of scope
- Deleting or merging anything without the owner.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, DIG-02: {{ROADMAP}}
- Most states have no prototype screen yet. Prototype them first.

=== ISSUE RES-01
title: [RES-01] Link research and suggestions
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:knowledge
milestone: P6 Research and knowledge
---
**Phase:** P6 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v86, v94) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{BM-01}}, {{IDEA-01}}, {{PROJ-01}}

## Goal
After a save, Mnemo suggests what to do with the link, based on what the owner already has.

## Proposed change
- Up to 4 suggestions after a save: add to a project, use as a source, plan to read, compare, new idea.
- They come from tags, saved items and About me.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each suggestion names the saved item or tag it comes from.
- [ ] Nothing is created until the owner presses a suggestion.

## Out of scope
- Deep research ({{RES-02}}).

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, RES-01: {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, suggestions (v86, v94): {{PROTO}}

=== ISSUE RES-02
title: [RES-02] Deep research
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:knowledge
milestone: P6 Research and knowledge
---
**Phase:** P6 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v87, v111) · **Size:** L (guess, split it when the phase starts) · **Blocked by:** {{AGT-01}}, {{RES-01}}

## Goal
A background run researches one link in depth and writes a report the owner can trust.

## Proposed change
- A run that splits into three helpers (web, the owner's library, About me) and writes a report with "How it ran" and its sources.
- A checkbox under the link box turns it on for one save.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The report lists every page it read.
- [ ] A guess is marked as a guess.
- [ ] The run shows in Background runs and can be cancelled.

## Out of scope
- Research that runs with no link from the owner.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, RES-02: {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, deep research (v87, v111): {{PROTO}}
- Open point: a deep run may use a lot of the shared usage limit. Measure one run before this ships.

=== ISSUE RES-03
title: [RES-03] Link to idea to project flow
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:knowledge
milestone: P6 Research and knowledge
---
**Phase:** P6 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v94) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{RES-02}}, {{IDEA-01}}, {{PROJ-01}}, {{AGT-02}}

## Goal
One saved link can become an idea and then a project, with two approvals by the owner.

## Proposed change
- A five-step bar from link to project.
- Approval 1 makes an idea from the report. Approval 2 promotes it to a project, with a preview.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Neither step happens without the owner's approval.
- [ ] The idea keeps its source link, and the project keeps the idea.
- [ ] Phase exit: one saved link goes through research to an idea and a project, with two approvals.

## Out of scope
- Skipping an approval.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, RES-03 and the P6 exit check: {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, flow bar (v94): {{PROTO}}

=== ISSUE KNOW-01
title: [KNOW-01] About me
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:knowledge
milestone: P6 Research and knowledge
---
**Phase:** P6 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v91, v106) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{AGT-02}}

## Goal
Mnemo knows the owner's work, projects, interests and learning goals, so its suggestions fit.

## Proposed change
- A profile with four parts: work, current projects, interests, learning goals.
- A GitHub repo list. Mnemo reads only README, description and topics, and only for repos that are switched on.
- Suggested updates need Approve.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No line is added before Approve.
- [ ] A repo with the switch off is never read.

## Out of scope

=== ISSUE KNOW-02
title: [KNOW-02] Graph: an index for AI agents
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:knowledge
milestone: P6 Research and knowledge
---
**Phase:** P6 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** partly prototyped (v63, v65, picture only) · **Size:** L (guess, split it when the phase starts) · **Blocked by:** {{DATA-01b}}, {{LIB-01}}

## Goal
An index of every item and how items link, so an AI agent finds saved items fast. The picture comes second.

## Proposed change
- Plain code rules build the links. Each link has a kind and a reason. No embeddings.
- The graph covers every item type and can be rebuilt from the data at any time.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The graph can be deleted and rebuilt with no loss.
- [ ] Every link has a kind and a reason.
- [ ] A deleted item never shows.

## Out of scope
- A pretty graph picture as the main goal.
- Embeddings.

## Evidence and links
- Roadmap, KNOW-02 and the rule "No embeddings" (graph decision of 2026-11-12): {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, graph picture (v63, v65): {{PROTO}}

=== ISSUE LEARN-01
title: [LEARN-01] Learning paths
type: Feature
labels: priority:low, area:knowledge
milestone: P6 Research and knowledge
---
**Phase:** P6 (after version 1) · **Roadmap status:** prototyped (v37, v39, v53) · **Size:** M (guess) · **Blocked by:** {{DATA-01b}}, {{DAY-03}}

## Goal
The owner learns a topic in short sessions, with steps linked to saved items.

## Proposed change
- A path has a goal, a "Done when" line and steps (Read, Watch, Practice, Recall) linked to saved items.
- "Next session" picks steps for 10, 20 or 30 minutes. Each step can hold a note.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Ticking a step asks for one line the owner learned.
- [ ] A session can be added to the Calendar.

## Out of scope
- Paths written by AI with no saved items behind them.

- Roadmap, LEARN-01: {{ROADMAP}}
- Prototype, Learning paths (v37, v39, v53): {{PROTO}}
